title: What Is Trauma
learningGoal: Help parents understand what trauma is and how it affects children.
microLesson: Trauma is an overwhelming experience that exceeds a child’s ability to cope. It can come from violence, neglect, instability, or frightening events. Trauma affects behaviour, emotions, and relationships. Understanding trauma helps parents respond with empathy and safety.
activity: Write a reflection on one way trauma may have affected your child’s behaviour.
